name: 数学奇遇记 视觉系统

meta.source: projects/math-deck (the values its eight slides use)

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The background every slide fades to; the outer stop of the radial backdrop.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: The inner stop of the radial backdrop, behind the animation.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and primary text, on night and night-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body sentences and card captions, on night and night-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Footers and page numbers only (24px), on night.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, the card stroke and the first gradient stop; as text, on night.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The one big number a slide is about, on night or a card.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: The second gradient stop; highlights in the animations.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Rings and orbits in the animations; never body text.

tokens.name: card-fill
tokens.usage: The card's tint over the backdrop.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The accent other surfaces pick up; an alias of cyan.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: ZCOOL QingKe HuangYou at weight 400 only: it has no bold.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: The cover's title, once, with the cyan→pink gradient clipped to the glyphs.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: Each episode's title, at the top margin.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The answer, in gold, inside a card.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: 一根绳子紧紧绕地球赤道一圈。
styles.usage: The question the slide asks; ink-muted, 520–620px wide.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Episode number and topic above the title, in cyan.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Card captions and footers; the smallest size on a slide.

tokens.name: space-card-gap
tokens.usage: Between the number and the caption inside a card.

tokens.name: space-card-x
tokens.usage: A card's side padding (28px top and bottom).

tokens.name: space-margin
tokens.usage: The slide margin; 160px at the bottom where a footer sits.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The halo around a highlighted point in the animations.
